evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions concerns or stressors about this mover about moving in general... steep driveway access issues maybe" — asked after garage/appliances/packing/boxes/parking probing was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern ("you do have to go up a short flight of stairs to get in"); rep followed with one confirming question ("just a short flight of stairs and then the door, is that right?") rather than digging further
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we only charge in fifteen minute intervals" (beats-it-pay-less) + factors-driven range explanation citing stairs and missing furniture (window); no rate-commitment, self-prep-tip, or fairness-check lines

top_strength: No framing skipped on the quote itself — clean, complete pricing pitch covering all-inclusive rate, damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, and On-Time Guarantee in one clear pass.
coaching_note: The one real concern the customer raised (stairs at the new house) got a single confirming question instead of a real second layer of follow-up (e.g. "anything about the stairs that worries you") — that's the highest-value miss on this call.
